| Priority | Issue | Customer Impact |
|---|---|---|
| 🔴 **CRITICAL** | No AWS Support plan → Health API/EventBridge completely dark | Zero advance warning for any AWS Health event |

| 🟠 **HIGH** | All 15 rules → 1 SNS topic → 1 external SQS (no humans) | No ops team or owner ever notified |
| 🟠 **HIGH** | Inconsistent/missing tags on 3 of 4 instances | Blast-radius attribution and owner routing impossible |
| 🟠 **HIGH** | All 4 production instances in single AZ (us-east-1b) | Single AZ Health event = 100% compute outage |
| 🟡 **MEDIUM** | IMDSv1 permitted, 0 CloudWatch alarms, open SG | Increased attack surface and zero pre-event visibility |

**The routing plan in priority order:** P0: Support upgrade → P0: aws.health EventBridge rule → P0: Tag taxonomy → P1: Per-owner SNS fan-out + enrichment Lambda + AZ distribution → P2: IMDSv2 + CloudWatch alarms + SG remediation → P3: Dedicated health event bus.
